preamble: Delateralization and backing of the retroflex lateral [ɭ] to the voiced velar fricative [ɣ]. This is documented in the central Paiwan Raxekerek regional group of Taiwan, where Proto-Paiwan *ɭ (elsewhere preserved as [ɭ], spelled ⟨l⟩) weakened along the trajectory *ɭ > ɣ > ∅. Raxekerek is at the [ɣ] stage, contrasting it with a uvular fricative from *r, while neighbouring Tjuvecekadan has completed the loss of the fricative.

examples.note: Most Paiwan dialects keep *ɭ as retroflex [ɭ]; in the Raxekerek group it became a velar fricative, which contrasts phonemically with the uvular fricative from *r. In Tjuvecekadan the same *ɭ > ɣ went on to zero, leaving vowel sequences such as q<em>ili [qə.ˈmii].

sources: Yeh, S. S. (2025). New Vowels and the Lost Uvular Consonant in Tjuvecekadan Paiwan. Tsing Hua Journal of Chinese Studies, 55(4), 683–716. https://doi.org/10.6503/THJCS.202512_55(4).0003
